title: Cast Iron vs. PVC in Drain, Waste, and Vent Systems
description: Selecting the right piping material for Drain, Waste, and Vent systems impacts sound transmission, chemical resistance, and installation efficiency. Schedule 40 PVC is lightweight, highly resistant to corrosion, and economical, making it a popular choice for residential construction. However, waste flow through plastic pipes generates noticeable acoustic noise inside walls. Heavy cast iron piping, typically joined with heavy-duty shield couplings, provides superior sound dampening, high thermal resistance, and exceptional fire-rated wall performance. Understanding these material characteristics allows plumbers to recommend optimal solutions based on acoustic requirements, fire ratings, and project budgets.
